description.html: This 35x25x30 cm glass terrarium with a volume of 26.3 liters comes with a handmade 3D background that gives the interior the look of a natural habitat. The polystyrene background is sculpted as rock, tree bark or cave relief, and every piece is unique because it is made by hand in our workshop.

The horizontal layout with 35 cm of length gives a floor area where a basking zone, a cool zone and a hiding area are easy to arrange. Terrestrial reptiles actively choose their temperature by moving between zones, and this space lets them do that. The ventilation openings are placed to create natural airflow from bottom to top, which maintains optimal humidity.

If the standard dimensions don't suit you, we build custom terrariums. Choose the size, film pattern, background style and extras such as LED lighting or a thermostat. Contact us for a quote. We deliver across Serbia.
